author: architect (Claude Opus 5.5, Medium), user-approved 2026-11-05
amends_nothing: The frozen protocol, frozen models, blend addendum, candidates, window and gates are unchanged. This record only fixes phase 2 execution details that the protocol left open, before any 2026/27 prediction, outcome or availability content has been read.
timing_rule: Intended to be first pushed before the GW10 deadline. If the first push is later, every rule below still applies unchanged and the phase 2 report must state the push time.

gaps_closed.fixed_squad: Protocol gate 6 (mean fixed-squad delta >= 0) gives no 2026/27 squad specification; the phase 1 selector is hard-wired to 2025/26 GW20.
gaps_closed.label_path: The protocol's unchanged incumbent_availability.augment is hard-wired to 2025/26, and fplcache_availability refuses seasons after 2025/26, so no admitted code path attaches 2026/27 labels.
gaps_closed.label_fallback: The protocol names AIrsenal 2026/27 as the only label source and gives no rule for a gameweek it does not cover.
gaps_closed.runtime: The freeze record does not state the runtime in which the frozen models must be loaded.

fixed_squad.method: fplcache_availability.fixed_squad as released in 5927716 (selector, legality, autosubstitution and replay unchanged; its 2025/26 GW20 replica reproduced the PR66 totals and squad hash exactly), applied to season 2026-27 through a new module that only widens the season scope
fixed_squad.pool: unchanged: opening-gameweek rows with n_history >= 3 and last5_minutes >= 45; price = latest history value strictly more than 3 hours before the opening cutoff; draw weight = max(ew4_points_core, 0.1)
fixed_squad.horizon: opening gameweek through GW38, realised points via the unchanged points_replay
fixed_squad.candidates: the same 20 squads for control, conditional and blend_equal; each arm picks its XI each gameweek with the unchanged select_xi from its own forecasts
fixed_squad.gate_6_statistic: mean over the 20 squads of (candidate total - control total)
fixed_squad.shortfall: If fewer than 20 legal unique squads are found within the unchanged 10,000 draws, stop; do not change the seed, pool or count.

labels.primary_source: AIrsenal 2026/27 under the protocol's exact-prefix commit-time and identity rule, labels for each gameweek's own next round only
labels.identity: join by (season, gameweek, fpl_code), as fplcache amendment 2; positions must match; history rows with no source code stay unknown and are counted
labels.encoding: unchanged SIGNALS: finite label -> chance = label/100, missing = 0; null label or no observation -> chance 0, missing 1
labels.code_path: a new module generalising fplcache_availability.augment to 2026-27 with identical encoding; before use it must reproduce the incumbent 2025/26 SIGNALS bytes exactly, as the fplcache package did
labels.fallback: For any 2026/27 gameweek with no admissible AIrsenal observation, use the fplcache snapshot selected under fplcache-r2 rules (last snapshot strictly before the deadline, at most 24 hours old, adding commit pinned, published_at = max(path time, commit time), Assistant Managers excluded) with amendment 2 identity. Fallback is per gameweek, never per player. If neither source covers a gameweek, its rows stay unknown.
labels.fallback_basis: fplcache and AIrsenal agreed on 99.84% of shared 2025/26 keys (minimum 99.03% per gameweek).
labels.coverage_not_checked: No 2026/27 listing, existence check or content read of either archive has been made before this record.
labels.report: per-gameweek source (AIrsenal, fplcache fallback, none) and known-label counts

calendar.no_fixture_gameweeks: a gameweek with no fixtures has no rows and is reported as no_fixtures
calendar.double_gameweeks: fixture rows are kept; player-GW values are sums over fixtures, as in benchmark_metrics.evaluate
calendar.deadlines: re-verified from the official event deadlines at phase 2; a first prospective gameweek other than GW10 stops

runtime.requirement: load and predict with the frozen models only in the runtime that fitted them: Python 3.12.16, scikit-learn 1.9.1, NumPy 2.3.5, pandas 2.2.3
runtime.canary: before phase 2, a separately authorised readiness package records the full package list and a prediction hash of both frozen models on a fixed historical row set; phase 2 must reproduce that hash before scoring
runtime.on_mismatch: stop; never refit, re-save or convert a frozen model

remaining_ambiguity: Any further gap found at phase 2 stops the package. Its resolution must be mechanical, decided without computing any candidate metric, and disclosed in the report as post-registration.
not_authorised: any 2026/27 prediction, outcome or availability read before the phase 2 package
refitting or modifying either frozen model
any change to the frozen protocol, freeze record or blend addendum
new candidates, arms, weights or gates
